verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a downloadable machine-readable OpenAPI document at supabase.com/openapi.json that contains an "openapi" key, so the vendor does publish an OpenAPI spec. Nothing in the pack shows that this spec covers the Auth API endpoints rather than another Supabase API, and no docs describe it. Missing for 10: confirmation the spec covers Supabase Auth endpoints, first-party documentation of the spec and how to download it, independent or hands-on corroboration of its completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
